items.title: PPL Corp.’s (PPL) Guidance Holds Steady Amid A Data Center Gold Rush
items.summary: On August 7, PPL Corporation (NYSE:PPL) reported second-quarter earnings that kept its long-term growth story fully intact. Reported earnings jumped 26% to $230 million, or $0.30 per share, while earnings from ongoing operations rose to $0.33 per share from $0.32 a year earlier. The company reaffirmed its full-year guidance of $1.90 to $1.98 per share […]
